Subject: Ostrem Warehousing - Quote in Progress

Hi Celia,

Thanks for the submission on Ostrem Warehousing! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward with quoting.

I have a few questions before I can finalize terms:

- Can you confirm the primary commodities stored at each location?
- What fire protection systems are in place (sprinklers, alarms, monitoring)?
- Are any locations equipped with temperature-controlled storage?
- What security measures are maintained (fencing, cameras, guards)?
- Any hazardous materials stored?

Once I have these details, I'll work up competitive terms for the 12/6/26 effective date.

Thanks for thinking of us!

[Underwriter name]
